findings.text: Program descriptor uses one bit marker jit_required to record mandatory just in time need and marker gpl_compatible for license status and marker cb_access for control block touch and marker dst_needed for destination requirement and marker blinding_requested for blinding need and marker blinded for blinding done and marker is_func for function nature and marker kprobe_override for probe override and marker has_callchain_buf for callchain storage and marker enforce_expected_attach_type for attach checking and marker call_get_stack for stack helper and marker call_get_func_ip for address helper and marker call_session_cookie for cookie helper and marker tstamp_type_access for timestamp field use and marker sleepable for sleepable execution.

Program core records classification in field type and expected attach classification in field expected_attach_type and filter count in field len and just in time size in field jited_len and identity as either digest or tag sharing storage and per cpu statistics in field stats and per cpu recursion guard in field active sized by context count and dispatch entry in field bpf_func and auxiliary data in field aux and original classic view in field orig_prog and trailing flexible storage for either classic insns or extended insnsi sharing memory.
Array auxiliary record tracks direct jump users through list poke_progs and back pointer map and mutual exclusion poke_mutex and deferred work item work for poke maintenance.

Link object holds reference count refcnt and numeric id and link classification type and operation table ops and associated program prog and flag word flags and attach classification attach_type and shared storage for either deferred free head rcu or work item work with no overlap in time and boolean sleepable describing link hook sleep semantics separately from program sleep semantics.

Link operation table offers release for drop and dealloc for immediate teardown without grace wait and dealloc_deferred for teardown after grace wait with chained grace periods when sleepable and detach for unlink and update_prog for program swap with old and new inputs and show_fdinfo for diagnostic output and fill_link_info for information export and update_map for map swap and poll for file readiness.

Trampoline attachments build from small node holding link and hash member and cookie value. Single entry link adds node to base link while shim adds trampoline pointer. Tracing link adds extra exit node plus trampoline plus target program. Multi attach link keeps data tables plus cookie array plus exit array plus count plus flexible node array sized by count with counted by annotation. Raw tracepoint link adds event map pointer btp plus cookie. Primer bundles link with file plus descriptor plus id for creation.

Mount options record owner uid and group gid and mode value plus delegation mask delegate_cmds for commands and mask delegate_maps for maps and mask delegate_progs for programs and mask delegate_attachs for attach operations plus attribute cache xa_cache. Token holds work item plus reference refcnt plus namespace userns plus allowed mask allowed_cmds and mask allowed_maps and mask allowed_progs and mask allowed_attachs plus optional security pointer under hardening.
Maximum number of members in a structure operations definition is 64.

Operation set uses verifier_ops for verification plus init for setup plus check_member for member vetting plus init_member for member setup plus reg for activation plus unreg for removal plus update for replacement plus validate for final check plus cfi_stubs area plus owner module plus name text plus func_models array for calling conventions. Descriptor links st_ops with type and value_type and identifiers type_id and value_id and argument table arg_info. Argument info pairs info pointer with count cnt. Common value pairs reference refcnt with lifecycle state.

Lifecycle uses condition INIT for fresh and condition INUSE for active and condition TOBEFREE for awaiting reclaim and condition READY for validated availability. Full identifiers are BPF_STRUCT_OPS_STATE_INIT and BPF_STRUCT_OPS_STATE_INUSE and BPF_STRUCT_OPS_STATE_TOBEFREE and BPF_STRUCT_OPS_STATE_READY stored in common state field.

Recursion guard allows only one active entry per cpu context. ARM64 build tracks level from interrupt context with preemption paused during increment and validates single bit pattern, while generic build uses per cpu increment returning success only on transition to one with matching decrement on exit. Acquire reports boolean and release restores prior level.

Predicate for multi tracing is true for kind BPF_TRACE_FENTRY_MULTI and for kind BPF_TRACE_FEXIT_MULTI and for kind BPF_TRACE_FSESSION_MULTI and false otherwise. Predicate for structure operation trampoline is true only when fentry node count equals one and the sole node link type equals BPF_LINK_TYPE_STRUCT_OPS.

Enabled registration builds a wrapper with common header plus aligned data payload for the requested type and emits type metadata then invokes internal registration. Disabled registration ignores input and reports zero. Dummy state holds integer val and dummy operations offer test_1 for simple call plus test_2 for multi argument call plus test_sleepable for sleepable call.

Module reference handling branches on owner sentinel. Matching sentinel uses structure operation reference helpers, other owners use generic module reference helpers. Disabled builds always use generic helpers and report not supported or invalid for structure operation queries and link creation and association and lookup, with disassociation and info fill and descriptor release as no operation returning null where applicable.

Session count iterates fentry table selected by BPF_TRAMP_FENTRY and counts programs with expected attach BPF_TRACE_FSESSION plus programs with expected attach BPF_TRACE_FSESSION_MULTI. Cookie count iterates same table and counts nodes where helper flag call_session_cookie is set. Single check reads call_session_cookie from node program.
Cgroup shim link operation reports operation not supported and unlink operation performs no action in this configuration.

Array map holds base map plus size elem_size plus mask index_mask plus helper aux plus flexible trailing area used as value bytes or as ptrs entries or as pptrs per cpu entries with eight byte alignment.
Verification complexity limit is 1000000 instructions and tail call chain limit is 33.

Loop bound BPF_MAX_LOOPS is 8388608 and timed loop bound BPF_MAX_TIMED_LOOPS is 65535. Access mask BPF_F_ACCESS_MASK combines read only with read only program with write only with write only program. Read flag BPF_MAP_CAN_READ is 1 and write flag BPF_MAP_CAN_WRITE is 2.
Maximum user ring buffer samples per operation is 131072.

Capability mapping checks BPF_F_RDONLY_PROG to grant BPF_MAP_CAN_READ and checks BPF_F_WRONLY_PROG to grant BPF_MAP_CAN_WRITE and grants both when neither is set, treating both set as impossible. Validation fails when both program flags are present. Owner helpers allocate zeroed object under atomic context and release it. Map kind test is true for BPF_MAP_TYPE_PROG_ARRAY and for BPF_MAP_TYPE_DEVMAP and for BPF_MAP_TYPE_CPUMAP.
Event entry holds event pointer plus perf_file plus map_file plus rcu head for deferred free.
Context helpers define copy callback for buffer transfer and convert callback for access translation keyed by access kind.
Array item holds prog pointer plus shared field used as cgroup_storage array or as bpf_cookie value. Collection holds rcu head plus trailing items sequence ending with null prog entry.

Execution context base is empty and extended for cgroup runs with program item plus return value and for trace runs with cookie plus uprobe marker and for trampoline runs with cookie plus saved context.

Installer bpf_set_run_ctx stores new context in current task and returns prior value, while restore bpf_reset_run_ctx writes back prior value. Both act only when syscall support is enabled and otherwise leave task state unchanged.
Flag BPF_RET_BIND_NO_CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE equals 1 and flag BPF_RET_SET_CN equals 1, each as single low bit.

Standard array execution requires read copy update held and disables migration and installs trace context marked as non uprobe, then walks items until null program loading each entry once and setting cookie and calling supplied runner, combining results with logical and from initial true and returning true when array is absent.

Uprobe array execution allows faulting and requires trace read copy update, disables migration, marks context as uprobe, then walks items until null, acquiring read copy update around non sleepable programs only while sleepable programs run without that hold, combining results with logical and from true and returning true for absent array.

Standard runner must hold read copy update and disable migration across whole walk with context save and restore. Uprobe runner must hold trace read copy update and disable migration, with inner read copy update toggled per program based on sleepable marker. Instrumentation guard disables migration and increments per cpu active depth on entry and decrements and reenables migration on exit.

Read copy update held test is true when normal or trace or bottom half hold is present. Fault possibility marker expands to file and line report in debug builds and to no operation otherwise. Instrumentation helpers are balanced and nest via per cpu counter.
Program type declaration exposes operation and verifier tables for named kind, map type declaration exposes operation table, link type declaration carries no expansion in this header.

File descriptor lookup for maps and for type information rejects empty descriptor with bad file error and rejects mismatched operation table with invalid argument error, otherwise returns stored private object.

Map memory helpers forward to general node allocate and lockless allocate and zeroed allocate and array zeroed allocate and per cpu allocate, ignoring map argument for policy. Memory cgroup enter and exit are no operation clearing output pointers.

Element count storage is per cpu allocation sized for counter with user and no warn flags, reporting no memory on failure. Free releases per cpu area while increment and decrement adjust local cpu value.

Leak permission and uninit stack permission each check CAP_PERFMON through token helper. Token helper succeeds when capable holds requested cap or when capable holds CAP_SYS_ADMIN for other caps. Speculation bypass for version one and version four succeeds when just in time bypass is set or mitigations are disabled or token holds CAP_PERFMON.
Iterator prefix constant equals bpf_iter_.
Iterator definition helper declares external iterator entry then provides initial implementation returning zero.

Task kinds are BPF_TASK_ITER_ALL for all and BPF_TASK_ITER_TID for thread and BPF_TASK_ITER_TGID for group. Auxiliary record holds map for element walks and start plus order for cgroup walks and type plus pid for task walks.
Iterator callbacks provide attach for program binding and detach for release and fdinfo display and link info fill and prototype lookup for helper resolution.

Teardown path differs for sleepable versus non sleepable links with chained grace waits for sleepable and alternative grace for non sleepable tracepoints, risking premature free if wrong path chosen. Uprobe walk must not hold read copy update across sleepable programs and must allow faults. Recursion guard must be paired and architecture specific. Blinding state must persist from request to completion before execution.
